WHO WE ARE

A Nova Scotia platform built for the long view.

Plexus Development Group brings development, land and investment thinking together around places that can serve communities and create durable value. Based in Halifax, the group evaluates opportunities across housing, commercial space and strategic land, working with project teams and partners to move ideas through planning and delivery.
